domain.carrier: one twelve-port icosahedral carrier with thirty seams
domain.preparation: one nonnegative integer load; retained G; zero initial tape
domain.schedules: lexicographically first shortest seam-index word per ordered pair of distinct ports
domain.fair_history_weight: 2^(-schedule_length), normalized separately for each configured pair
domain.regions: all 4096 subsets, including empty and whole carrier, at every source prefix
domain.exact_arithmetic: Python integers and fractions.Fraction for current, load, continuity and regional claims

independent_algorithms.schedules: enumerate simple edge words through length three and minimize (length, seam word)
independent_algorithms.geometry: orient primal triangles consistently, then traverse outgoing primal edges around each port
independent_algorithms.source: balanced division of the two endpoint loads, separately implemented
independent_algorithms.regions: explicit subset-sum enumeration, cached by the exact charge vector
independent_algorithms.curve: analytic complex sine/cosine evaluation on a uniform mesh; integrate argument of consecutive ratios
independent_algorithms.receipt: exact required key sets, exact counts and event witnesses, finite residuals, all required source pins and scope flags

native.required: exact continuity, one whole unit and integral regional domain at every step; glued curves and degree equal to held current

half_current.required: exact continuity passes; one-unit/integral-regional domain fails; phase gluing fails

random_integer.required: topology passes all histories while unit and regional-domain gates reject some histories

omitted_record.mutation: omit the first nonzero current from held tape in each affected history
omitted_record.required: held tape retains valid integer degree; source-load comparison rejects exactly the affected histories

adversarial_controls: forged counts with all checks true
omitted witness event or prefix check
turn-32 alias rejected by actual domain gate
zero crossing, open contour and unresolved increments rejected

interpretation.identity: B F = G - n follows from matched load and tape updates; phase degree is the encoded tape period
interpretation.unit: one integer register load; an even load stack can divide under the same native law
interpretation.homotopy: free homotopy permits shared vertex phases to move; fixed-vertex homotopy is not asserted
interpretation.observer: declared current encoding, not an independently evolving field sensor; native pointer reads counters
interpretation.record_loss: external comparison with source loads detects loss; tape-only winding cannot detect every lost integer record
interpretation.scope: no transfer to glued carriers, no physical electric normalization, no mass/spin/force claim, no official OpenWave validation
